result.body:
AMD DEVELOPER HACKATHON KICKS OFF TODAY.
WATCH THE STREAM. START BUILDING.
$21,500 IN PRIZES. A RADEON™ GPU. 
YOUR LAST CALL TO JOIN. 

REGISTER TODAY 
￼
Hey Builder,

Today we kick off the AMD Developer Hackathon - and if you haven't registered yet, this is your last chance.

Hit the link above, register now, read all the details on the challenge carefully, and explore the tech resources before you start building ⬇️

JOIN THE KICK-OFF STREAM TODAY

📅 May 4 | 9 AM PST
📺 Watch live on Twitch, YouTube or X!

Tune in to make sure you're all set to start building.
If you have any questions, head straight to our Discord Server. Today at 10 AM PST we will host a Q&A session. We're always there to help you out!

POWERED BY

This hack is brought to you by an incredible lineup of partners making it all possible:
Akash Systems × MindsDB × NYSE Wired × theCUBE × Hugging Face × Qwen × ModelScope

TECHNOLOGY & ACCESS

This hackathon gives you on-demand access to AMD's cloud-based AI stack - no hardware, no complex setup. Just powerful compute and the freedom to build what you actually care about.

How to Get Started
Sign up for the hackathon
Then click "sign up with AMD"
Unlock $100 in AMD Developer Cloud credits
Spin up your environment and start building
Go solo or team up - ship something real
YOU'RE IN
What's Included
All participants get:
$100 in AMD Developer Cloud credits (AMD AI Developer Program members)
Access to AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs
Curated AI courses and tutorials
1-month complimentary DeepLearning.AI Pro membership
Everything runs fully in the cloud - no hardware required

TRACKS
🤖 Track 1: AI Agents & Agentic Workflows (Best for Beginners)
Build intelligent AI systems that automate workflows, coordinate agents, or assist users in complex tasks.
⚡ Track 2: Fine-Tuning on AMD GPUs (Advanced / GPU-Intensive)
Fine-tune open-source models for high-impact domain specialization using direct GPU access.
🎨 Track 3: Vision & Multimodal AI
Build applications that process images, video, and audio using the massive memory bandwidth of AMD GPUs.
🚢  Extra: Ship It + Build in Public
Document your journey, share on socials, open-source your project. Dedicated prize pool for the best stories.

All resources can be found on the main Hackathon page in the Technology section.

PRIZES
💰 $21,500+ total prize pool
🏆 Grand Prize: $5,000
🎮 Hardware Prize: 1 × AMD Radeon™ AI PRO R9700 GPU
🥇 Track winners: $2,500 / $1,500 / $1,000 across all three tracks
🤗 Hugging Face Special Prize: Reachy Mini Wireless robot + PRO memberships + credits

COMPLETE REGISTRATION 
HUNGRY FOR MORE? CHECK OTHER UPCOMING HACKATHONS BELOW

￼
JOIN IBM BOB HACKATHON! 
May 15-17 | Online | $10,000 prize pool
AI that actually reads your code. Build tools and workflows that make developers faster -  with IBM Bob as your partner in the repo, not just the chat window. 48 hours to show what that looks like in practice.


￼
JOIN TRANSFORMING ENTERPRISE THROUGH AI HACKATHON 
May 11-19 | San Jose & Online | $10,000 prize pool 
Enterprise-grade AI that actually matters. Build it, then pitch live on a massive Silicon Valley main stage in front of the exact execs who buy and deploy AI at scale. Real feedback. Real buyers. Real trajectory-changing moments. 


￼
JOIN AI AGENT OLYMPICS HACKATHON 
May 13-20 | The Official Hackathon at Milan AI Week 2026 | $28,000 prize pool 
Build real enterprise-grade AI agents at scale on Europe’s biggest AI stage. Powered by Google Gemini + Vultr’s high-performance cloud. This is your shot to go from prototype to production in front of the sharpest minds in Europe. 

Let's build!
The LabLab team

result.summary:
Here are the main points of the AMD Developer Hackathon in bullet-point form:

• The AMD Developer Hackathon kicks off today and registration is open until further notice.
• There's a $21,500 prize pool with a Grand Prize of $5,000 and hardware prizes including an AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 GPU.
• Three tracks to participate in: AI Agents & Agentic Workflows, Fine-Tuning on AMD GPUs, and Vision & Multimodal AI.
• All participants get access to AMD's cloud-based AI stack with $100 in credits, curated AI courses, and a 1-month complimentary DeepLearning.AI Pro membership.
• The hackathon is powered by partners including Akash Systems, MindsDB, NYSE Wired, and Hugging Face.
• A Q&A session will be held today at 10 AM PST on the Discord Server.
• The hackathon runs from May 4 to [unknown end date].
• Participants can join solo or in teams and submit their projects for judging.
• Prizes include a Reachy Mini Wireless robot, PRO memberships, and credits.
